message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients you’ll need:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9 × 13 in. pan) |
|----------|------------|--------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | Dry lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | • Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1 ½ lb (680 g) |
| | • Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | • Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | • Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | • Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | • Olive oil | 1 Tbsp |
| | • Salt, pepper, oregano, basil, red‑pepper flakes | to taste |
| | • Optional: red wine, bay leaf, carrot & celery (finely diced) | ¼ cup wine, 1 bay leaf, ½ cup carrot & celery |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (beaten) | 1 |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt & pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel sauce** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk (whole or 2%) | 4 cups (1 L) |
| | Nutmeg (freshly grated) | pinch |
| | Salt & pepper | to taste |
| **Cheese topping** | Shredded mozzarella | 2 cups (200 g) |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Optional: shredded provolone or fontina | ½ cup |

### Optional Extras
- **Vegetables**: Sautéed spinach, zucchini, mushrooms, or bell peppers can be layered in place of or alongside the meat.
- **Herbs**: Fresh basil, oregano, thyme, or rosemary for extra aroma.
- **Spices**: A dash of smoked paprika or a splash of balsamic vinegar for depth.

With these ingredients, you’ll have everything you need to assemble a hearty, flavorful lasagna. Enjoy!
